text:
Introduction
This document outlines the equipment inspection, which must be performed on a 
monthly bases as indicated by M1in the title block for battery charger
Technical Specification:

The first draft is initiated by eng. Mohamed Fouad, tested by eng. Wageh Khalil, revised by MDEPCo. Quality control eng. Adel El Naggar, accepted by eng. 
Ali Zahran, general manager & eng. Samir Abd El Gillil MDEPC. quality control 
general director, approved by eng. Ahmed Sawwan head sector of Nubaria 
power station and certified by eng. Mohammed Nageb quality control head 
sector.
Safety 
Precautions
Work order must be issued
Wear safety gloves and clothes
Tools and 
Equipment
Suitable tool set (battery hydrometer)
Digital voltmeter
Vacuum cleaner or blower brush
Suitable tool set (battery hydrometer)
Digital voltmeter
Vacuum cleaner or blower brush
Work to be carried out
Measure voltage and density (specific gravity) for every cell
Clean it from air dust and dirty
Check the ventilation system
Measure the total voltage for the batteries
Measure positive voltage with earth
Measure negative voltage with earth
Check the liquid level inside the batteries
Measure compartment temperature
